system.description:
You sow seeds of foreign influence in a creature's mind. Make a Focused Attack at a creature within range that you can see. You deal half damage on a hit and the creature must make a Magykal Resistance. On a failure, you may choose one of the three conditions to inflict them with.

  • The creature becomes Panicked.
  • The creature becomes Confused.
  • The creature gains Stage 1 of the Poisoned Condition.

If the target fails the initial Magykal Resistance they can attempt to end the effect early as a Focused action on the following Challenger Phase. At the start of each of the following Challenger Phases the target can roll to Resist the effect at no cost.
